subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures keep the current generic direct-route 404 and improve authenticated UI diagnostics, or should `/avatar/{agentId}` expose more specific failure statuses for oversized, missing, or rejected files?
rationale: The remaining behavior sits on an authenticated local workspace file-serving path, where more detailed errors improve UX but can change information-disclosure boundaries.

options.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep direct image fetches generic while using metadata, Quick Settings, and chat surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

options.title: Expose Endpoint Errors
options.body: Return specific statuses such as 413 or 400 from the direct avatar route with explicit security review and tests proving no unsafe path details leak.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Avatar Contract
options.body: Defer the diagnostics choice into the broader avatar contract discussion at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41201.

recommendation.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetches generic while using metadata, Quick Settings, and chat surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for avatar route safety, size limits, and Control UI avatar reads points to this owner path.
